name: grit
description: Parts for the grit board that the flatland libraries do not have

socket-dip24-300.description: DIP-24 300 mil socket for an ATF22V10C (CONNFLY DS1009-24AT1NX-0A2 or equivalent; LCSC number to source); the GAL is supplied and programmed separately

socket-dip28-600.description: DIP-28 600 mil socket for an AS7C164A (CONNFLY DS1009-28AT1WX-0A2, LCSC C72121)

socket-dip32-600.description: DIP-32 600 mil socket for an SST39SF040 (CONNFLY DS1009-32AT1WX-0A2, LCSC C72122)

tl16c550d-lqfp48.description: TI TL16C550DPTR UART, LQFP-48 (PT); pins by package number. LCSC number to confirm

sp3232-tssop16.description: MaxLinear SP3232EEY-L/TR RS-232 transceiver, TSSOP-16 (LCSC C13482)

74hc541-soic20w.description: Nexperia 74HC541D,653 octal buffer, SOIC-20 wide (LCSC C126008)

74lvc1g157-sc88.description: Nexperia 74LVC1G157GW,125 single 2:1 multiplexer, SC-88: 1 I0, 2 I1, 3 S, 4 Y, 5 GND, 6 VCC (LCSC C135822)

74lvc1g14-sot23-5.description: TI SN74LVC1G14DBVR Schmitt inverter, SOT-23-5: 1 NC, 2 A, 3 GND, 4 Y, 5 VCC (LCSC C7835)

max811-sot143.description: Analog Devices MAX811LEUS+T reset supervisor 4.63 V, SOT-143: 1 GND, 2 RESET#, 3 MR#, 4 VCC. LCSC number to confirm

crystal-14.7456-3225.description: 14.7456 MHz crystal, 3225 four-pad, 12 pF (LCSC C2885591): pins 1 and 3 crystal, 2 and 4 case

osc-4mhz-5v-7050.description: 4.000 MHz 5 V CMOS oscillator, 7050 four-pad: 1 EN, 2 GND, 3 OUT, 4 VCC. Part and LCSC number to pick

tact-5.1.description: XKB TS-1187A-B-A-B tactile switch, 5.1 x 5.1 mm SMD (LCSC C318884); pads 1 and 3 are diagonal

slide-msk12c02.description: SHOU HAN MSK12C02 SPDT slide switch, SMD (LCSC C431540); pin 2 common

dipsw-em04q.description: Diptronics EM-04-Q 4-position SMD DIP switch (LCSC C501635); position k joins pins k and 9-k

header-2x10.description: 2x10 pin header, 2.54 mm, through hole; LCSC number to pick

header-1x03.description: 1x3 pin header, 2.54 mm, through hole; LCSC number to pick

db9-female-ra.description: DE-9 female, right angle, through hole (JLCPCB assembly library C9900026339); may need hand soldering

ao3401a-sot23.description: AOS AO3401A P-channel MOSFET, SOT-23: 1 G, 2 S, 3 D (LCSC C15127, JLCPCB basic)

fuse-1206.description: PTC resettable fuse, 1206 (SMD1206P110TF/16, 1.1 A hold, LCSC C523825)
